profile.headline: Software Engineer at Walmart
profile.summary: I'm a senior software engineer who loves to learn new things, like challenges, and is ready for change. I have almost 9 years of experience in backend (java) development with a little bit of hand on the front end (from previous work), have knowledge of CI/CD, Kafka, Docker, and Kubernetes along with other tools/frameworks. Experience with building pipelines to deploy services, and define microservices following the best practices available, in addition to that have experience with SQL and NoSQL databases like Mongo, Cosmos, MySQL, SQL server, MariaDB, and Azure SQL.
